VSAccountApplicationProvider.doc: An object to display app-specific providers in your app.

VSAccountManager.doc: The object that coordinates your app’s authentication requests with a TV provider’s authentication service.

VSAccountManagerResult.doc: An object that represents a request made for subscriber account information.

VSAccountMetadata.doc: A collection of information for a subscriber’s account.

VSAccountMetadataRequest.doc: An object that specifies what subscriber account information your app retrieves.

VSAccountProviderResponse.doc: An object that contains the response from the account provider.

VSAppleSubscription.doc: An Apple streaming service customer and their subscriptions.

VSAutoSignInToken.doc: A value that represents a person’s account and their consent to Automatic Sign-In.

VSAutoSignInTokenUpdateContext.doc: An object that contains information about a person’s choice in the Automatic Sign-In prompt.

VSSubscription.doc: An object that describes a subscriber’s access to content.

VSSubscriptionRegistrationCenter.doc: An object that stores subscription information that the system provides to the Apple TV app.

VSUserAccount.doc: An object that represents a user’s account.

VSUserAccountManager.doc: The object that coordinates your app’s user account actions.

VSAccountManagerDelegate.doc: The methods you use to respond to authentication view controller requests.

VSAccountAccessStatus.doc: Constants that represent your app’s access status to the user’s subscription information.

VSAccountAccessStatusDenied.doc: The user denied the app access to subscription information.

VSAccountAccessStatusGranted.doc: The user allowed the app to access subscription information.

VSAccountAccessStatusNotDetermined.doc: The user hasn’t chosen whether to allow the app to access subscription information.

VSAccountAccessStatusRestricted.doc: The app isn’t allowed to access subscription information.

VSAutoSignInAuthorization.doc: The possible states the framework sets for Automatic Sign-In.

VSAutoSignInAuthorizationDenied.doc: A state that indicates the person denied authorization.

VSAutoSignInAuthorizationGranted.doc: A state that indicates the person opts in to Automatic Sign-In.

VSAutoSignInAuthorizationNotDetermined.doc: A state that indicates the framework needs to reauthorize Automatic Sign-In.

VSErrorCode.doc: Error codes in the framework error domain.

VSOriginatingDeviceCategory.doc: Constants that represent whether the device from which the user originally registered is mobile.

VSOriginatingDeviceCategoryMobile.doc: A constant that indicates the original registering device is mobile.

VSOriginatingDeviceCategoryOther.doc: A constant that indicates the original registering device is not mobile.

VSSubscriptionAccessLevel.doc: Constants representing a subscriber’s level of access to your content.

VSSubscriptionAccessLevelFreeWithAccount.doc: The user has access to free content with a valid account.

VSSubscriptionAccessLevelPaid.doc: The user has access to content that requires a paid subscription.

VSUserAccountQueryOptions.doc: Constants that represent options you use to fetch a list of user accounts.

VSUserAccountQueryNone.doc: A constant that indicates fetching user accounts from the user’s current device only.

VSUserAccountType.doc: Constants that represent whether a user has access to paid content.

VSUserAccountTypeFree.doc: A constant that indicates a user has access to free content.

VSUserAccountTypePaid.doc: A constant that indicates a user has access to paid content.

-initWithLocalizedDisplayName:identifier.doc: Returns an application provider using a given display name and identifier.

-checkAccessStatusWithOptions:completion.doc: Checks your app’s access to user subscription information, and requests access if needed.

-enqueueAccountMetadataRequest:completio.doc: Submits a request for subscriber account information.

-cancel.doc: Cancels an in-progress request for subscriber account information.

+defaultSubscriptionRegistrationCenter.doc: Returns the default subscription registration center object.

-setCurrentSubscription:.doc: Sets the subscription information for the current user.

-deleteAutoSignInTokenWithCompletionHand.doc: Deletes the value of the current Automatic Sign-In token.

-queryAutoSignInTokenWithCompletionHandl.doc: Retrieves the current Automatic Sign-In token.

-queryUserAccountsWithOptions:completion.doc: Returns a list of registered user accounts for your app.

-requestAutoSignInAuthorizationWithCompl.doc: Presents a modal sheet that offers a person to opt in to Automatic Sign-In.

-updateAutoSignInToken:updateContext:com.doc: Sets the current Automatic Sign-In token.

identifier.doc: A string that identifies a provider.

localizedDisplayName.doc: The display name of the provider as it will appear in the list of providers.

delegate.doc: The delegate of the account manager object.

SAMLAttributeQueryResponse.doc: The SAML response from the account provider.

accountProviderIdentifier.doc: The unique identifier of the account provider.

accountProviderResponse.doc: The response from the account provider.

authenticationExpirationDate.doc: The date when the user’s current authentication session expires.

verificationData.doc: Data you use to verify that the response came from the account provider.

accountProviderAuthenticationToken.doc: An authentication session token that your app sends to the account provider.

applicationAccountProviders.doc: An array of application-specific providers to add to the list of account providers.

attributeNames.doc: The SAML attributes that your app sends to the account provider.

channelIdentifier.doc: The channel identifier for the request.

featuredAccountProviderIdentifiers.doc: The providers your app lists prominently during authentication.

forceAuthentication.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app ignores cached credentials.

includeAccountProviderIdentifier.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether your app requests the identifier of the account provider.

includeAuthenticationExpirationDate.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether your app requests the expiration date of the user’s current authentication session.

interruptionAllowed.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether your app can prompt the user to authenticate to complete the request.

localizedVideoTitle.doc: A short, user-presentable name for the video that the user wants to play.

supportedAccountProviderIdentifiers.doc: A list of identifiers for TV providers that your app supports.

supportedAuthenticationSchemes.doc: A collection of authentication schemes your app supports for this request.

verificationToken.doc: A token that your app sends to an account provider to identify itself.

authenticationScheme.doc: The authentication scheme type of the response.

body.doc: The raw response from the provider.

status.doc: The status code for the response.

authorization.doc: A state that represents a person’s approval of Automatic Sign-In.

value.doc: A string that represents a person’s account.

authorization.doc: A state that represents a person’s approval of Automatic Sign-In.

accessLevel.doc: The subscriber’s level of access to your catalog of content.

expirationDate.doc: The date when the user’s subscription expires.

tierIdentifiers.doc: A list of content from your catalog that the subscriber can access.

VSUserAccountManager.AutoSignInAuthoriza.doc: The possible states the framework sets for Automatic Sign-In.

VSUserAccountManager.AutoSignInToken.doc: A value that represents a person’s account and their consent to Automatic Sign-In.

VSUserAccountManager.AutoSignInTokenUpda.doc: An object that contains information about a person’s choice in the Automatic Sign-In prompt.

VSUserAccountQueryOptions.doc: Constants that represent options you use to fetch a list of user accounts.

deleteAutoSignInToken().doc: Deletes the value of the current Automatic Sign-In token.

requestAutoSignInAuthorization().doc: Presents a modal sheet that offers a person to opt in to Automatic Sign-In.

sharedUserAccountManager.doc: A shared instance of the user account manager class.

updateAutoSignInToken(_:updateContext:).doc: Sets the current Automatic Sign-In token.

userAccounts(options:).doc: Returns a list of registered user accounts for your app.
